description: Echo Bots + Echo ADK inside Codex / GPT: list, create, run and govern Echo ADK agents and echoBots through the echo-adk-api contract on FORGE, via MCP.

defaultPrompt: Show the Echo ADK health and list my agents and bots.
List my echoBots and their statuses.
Run the forge-steward agent and report its Proof verdict.
interface.longDescription: MCP tools over the frozen echo-adk contract (FORGE loopback service): health, agent definitions, one-shot runs with a Proof verdict, and echoBots — always-on governed agents that start paused, hold one exact-scope Lease per turn, keep their own memory scope, and carry a daily cost cap of at most $5. Bots resume only on Bob's explicit word; the bridge refuses resume calls unless started with ECHO_ADK_ALLOW_RESUME=1 for an authorized session. The calling model is the brain; this is a tool bridge, not a model server.
interface.shortDescription: Governed Echo agents and echoBots from Codex

name: echo-adk
